rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Brümilda van Rensburg
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, before 2009).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2009 as 'Brümilda van Rensburg'.
Introduced in United States by Ludwig's Roses Phoenix in 2016 as 'Calm Composure'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink. Moderate fragrance. Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped, quartered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright.

Height: up to 6'7" (up to 200cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Produces many new basals.

Named for the well known South African actress and public speaker ‘Brümilda van Rensburg’.
